notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.12
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've just released a small batch of bugfixes and small adjustments to make our game run better than ever. 

Our main focus in this update is enhancing the Multiplayer experience, and also setting the stage for our first Big Update.

Here's a list of the most important changes:

[b]- In Multiplayer, you can now revive your partner by standing near him for a few seconds. Each consecutive revive reduces the total health gained after being revived.[/b]
- In Multiplayer, lives and continues are now shared.
- In Multiplayer, the amount of Score needed to get an Extra Life has been increased.

And some fixes:

- Fixed a bug where Ms. Igarashi health bar was absent from Multiplayer.
- Fixed a bug in Multiplayer where selecting Jasmin as P1 would block P2 from selecting Atsuko.
- HP and Energy collectables have been improved.
- A missing smoke VFX was restored.
- Some misc. UI bugs were fixed.

Join our Discord! https://discord.gg/XPjtqpnnBc

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.11 - Jasmin is here!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We've just published an update to include [b]Jasmin[/b], or newest playable character. Jasmin is still in active development, and as of now, she's equipped with a few placeholder sound effects and visual effects. Jasmin's storyline is also not finished yet. Her story will be fully told on our first Big Update.

We've also fixed bugs, tweaked some UI/UX elements, and added a disclaimer for the use of your Play Data for our Analytics system.

In the upcoming weeks, we'll share the first look on our third level, and a target release date for our first Big Update.

Our latest changes include:

- [b]You can now play as Jasmin![/b]
- New interactions have been added to bosses introduction scenes.
- Jasmin-related UI elements have been added.
- The tutorial prompts will now show correctly upon starting a new game.
- Analytics have been implemented. [b]Data collected is anonymous and no personal data is obtained.[/b]
- In-game HUD will now properly display the amount of Health and Energy.
- Fixed a few small bugs that could happen when switching from Level 1 -> Level 2.
- Font size/sharpness was tweaked.

Join our Discord! [url=https://discord.gg/XPjtqpnnBc]https://discord.gg/XPjtqpnnBc[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.04
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We've just published an update to fix a few minor bugs. 
We've also polished the use of various controllers, making coop an overall better experience.
If you're still having trouble using a controller, find the game properties on Steam -> Controllers -> Disable Steam Input

Feel free to report any others bugs you encounter.

Here's the list of changes:

- Improved controller support.
- Now you can select/confirm buttons using the Enter key on the numeric keypad.
- Various translation fixes.
- Game settings will now be properly saved upon closing.
- Fixed a bug where the game could start in co-op mode even with only one player.
- Updated some debris in Level 2.
- Made some small adjustments to the tutorial.
- The game is now paused when accessing the Steam overlay.
- Fixed a rare bug where the boss Charon could instantly die upon entering its second form.

Join our Discord! https://discord.gg/XPjtqpnnBc

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.02
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We at Mew Mew Media want to say a big thanks to everyone who's been supporting us since we launched Celestial Force.

We'll be sharing our next steps in this adventure soon, including a sneak peek at upcoming content updates.

[b]We're also aware of some issues that players are facing with regards to using Controllers/Joysticks. We're working on bringing a more solid implementation for Xbox, PS4, PS5, and other controllers in the next small update.[/b]

For now here's a list of the first batch of bug fixes, quality of life improvements, and small adjustments we've made:

- We made some behaviour changes to the bosses: Cerberus and Charon.
- The introduction cutscene was optimized to reduce stuttering.
- Fixed a little typo in our thank you message.
- Fixed a bug where you could dash and use skills in the pause menu.
- You can now go back to the previous screen from the saved games selection screen.
- Sped up a few interface animations.
- Added some missing English translations to Violetta's initial cutscene.
- When you press ESC with the pause menu open, it now selects the resume button.
- The Cerberus boss intro cutscene now properly changes based on your current character.
- You can now skip the thank you message by hitting "ESC."
- Fixed a bug where available inputs didn't update correctly in some situations.
- [b]Fixed an unintended interaction in co-op mode where both players could pick the same character.[/b]
- The bug where P2's chosen character's name was displayed incorrectly on the confirmation screen is fixed.
- The shadow for Atsuko in Phase 2 is now shown correctly.
- Other small UI adjustments were made.

[b]Wanna give us some feedback or chat about the game?[/b]
Join our Discord! https://discord.gg/XPjtqpnnBc
